title: JDBC Unity Catalog connections are now available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
JDBC Unity Catalog connections, including support for SSL certificates, are now available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Use JDBC Unity Catalog connections to connect to external databases with a custom JDBC driver, with access governed by Unity Catalog.

See [JDBC connection](/aws/en/connect/jdbc-connection).
